description:
### About file

NASA-0000023

by William Henry Lee (wlee@astroscu.unam.mx)

Gravitational radiation waveforms for black hole-neutron star coalescence calculations. The physical input is Newtonian physics, an ideal gas equation of state with varying compressibility (through the index gamma), and point-mass gravitational radiation backreaction, which is switched off in the simulation once the star is tidally disrupted. All the simulations are 3D, done using SPH.

See [webpage](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/black-hole-neutron-star-binary-mergers).

Main picture credit: [SXS](https://www.black-holes.org/)  
for a simulated image of two black holes merging
